name: marimekko-chart
title: Marimekko chart
description: A React Marimekko chart: a 100% stacked mosaic whose columns are as wide as their totals, showing market size and share in one picture. Accessible, MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Marimekko chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/marimekko

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { MarimekkoChart, MarimekkoTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/marimekko-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
